confusions: In the Barrow Antechamber, 'go north' led to the Throne on my first visit but to the Hall of Verses on my second visit (after having already collected the stone verse there) — the exits felt slightly inconsistent between visits, though it may just be that the route auto-collapses once a location's content is exhausted.
suggestions: Consider surfacing the 'ask reeve: the watch's aid' and similar reward-bearing dialogue options a bit earlier/more visibly, since they're easy to miss if a player doesn't re-ask after making a promise

The antechamber's side-trip hints ('what you find here can still shape how the ending goes') are a nice touch — more of that kind of foreshadowing would help players know optional content is worth the detour
The final throne menu with all 8 ending permutations spelled out in plain language is excellent — very clear about consequences before committing
